item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 31/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A humid maritime airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be windier over the coast of southeastern China towards the weekend. A trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to southern China early next week. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, it will become cold progressively over the region.
